task: Students set up a hanger and dial gauge on this aluminum beam. Which changes to how they use the apparatus could affect the measured displacement? Compare with the single weight at the free end.
clarifications: Does the beam's uniform cross-section and material properties remain unchanged when the hanger is placed at the clamp?

draft.title: What if the students place the hanger at the clamp instead of at the free end?
draft.hypothesis: The students could change the load application point from the free end to the clamp, altering the distribution of forces and potentially the measured displacement.
assumptions: The students are following the task instructions and using the provided reference model.
draft.question: What is the expected change in the maximum deflection or surface bending stress if the hanger is placed at the clamp instead of the free end? Provide a calculation based on the provided facts and the beam's properties.
